title: IPU conformance case setup
description: A conformance case's starting state and run limits (E04-31). From reset in `format`: load program.bin, write `registers`, then `xmem`, then `xmem_metadata`, set `fault_enables`, and run until HALT, a fault or `max_cycles` words.

description.description: What the case shows, in one line.

format.description: The run mode, by its element format (ADR 0007).

emulator_only.description: True when the hardware cannot run the case: FP32 mode or an EMULATOR slot's instruction.

max_cycles.description: The cycle limit (fault F-9); 0 disables it.

fault_enables.description: Fault enable bits other than the reset value (every fault enabled), by fault label.

registers.description: Every register to write; every other register starts at zero, but CR0 and CR1, the constants 0 and 1. In ipu_isa.registers order. `index` is the register within its bank.

name.description: The register bank (the suite README's table).

value.description: A scalar register (lr, cr): its unsigned 32-bit value.

hex.description: A vector register: its bytes, lowest address first.

xmem.description: XMEM regions to write; every other byte starts at zero.

xmem_metadata.description: Optional: XMEM row metadata words to write (NX8: scale[7:0], dynamic_exponent[8]); every other row's word starts at zero. Listed only when one is not zero.

row.description: The 128-byte XMEM unit (an NX8 row): its metadata address is row * 128.

word.description: The unsigned 16-bit word, four hex digits, most significant first: 0185 is scale 0x85, dynamic exponent 1.
